map.输入阅读字数和用时，计算您的阅读速度，并提供水平参考。: Enter the number of characters read and the time taken to compute your reading speed, with a level reference.
map.阅读速度 = 总字数 / 总用时（分钟）。理解度自评越高，实际有效阅读速度越有价: Reading speed = total characters / total time in minutes. The higher the self-rated comprehension, the more meaningful the effective reading speed.
map.建议先用完整文章测试，而非单段文字，以获得更准确结果。: Test with a full article rather than a single paragraph to get a more accurate result.
map.阅读速度应结合理解度综合评估。: Reading speed should be judged together with comprehension.
map.输入阅读字数与用时算每分钟字数（WPM）: Enter characters and time to compute words per minute (WPM)
map.结合理解度自评看有效: See the effective rate together with the comprehension self-rating
map.跟踪训练前后速度变化评估进步: Track speed changes before and after training to measure progress
map.读 3000 字用 10 分钟 → WPM = 3000/10 = 300 字/: Reading 3000 characters in 10 minutes gives WPM = 3000/10 = 300 characters/minute; Chinese native readers commonly reach 200-500 characters/minute, and mid-to-high comprehension is the healthiest combination.
map.同样 300 字/分钟，理解自评低（<60%）说明是「扫读」而非有效阅读；提效应: At the same 300 characters/minute, a low comprehension self-rating (<60%) means skimming rather than effective reading. Improvement should balance comprehension, not chase speed alone.
map.WPM = 总字数 / 总用时（分钟）；英文常以词计、中文以字计，跨语言比较需注: WPM = total characters / total time in minutes; English usually counts words while Chinese counts characters, so cross-language comparison must state the unit.
map.无绝对标准，关键看理解率；盲目提速若理解崩塌则无效，建议维持 80%+ 理解下的: There is no absolute standard; comprehension is what matters. Blindly raising speed is useless if comprehension collapses, so aim for your personal best speed while keeping comprehension above 80%.
map.阅读速度是衡量阅读效率的重要指标。本工具帮助您量化每分钟阅读的字数，并结合理解度: Reading speed is an important indicator of reading efficiency. This tool quantifies how many characters you read per minute and, together with your comprehension self-rating, gives an effective reading speed reference.
map.支持分钟和秒数精确输入: Supports precise input in minutes and seconds
map.内置计时器辅助测试: Built-in timer to assist the test
map.结合理解度评估有效速度: Assesses effective speed together with comprehension
map.速读课程前后对比: Before and after comparison for speed reading courses
